text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(Graceful models, planned composition,
lighting...
Fixes for Shion, Cheval's hurdles...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(Should reflect flawlessly in final cut...
Should, yet...)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Look troubled. Something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ah, reviewing photos...
something feels off.
Close to concept... but missing punch...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Not quite spectacular PR photos envisioned... Ah, planner's job. Will reconsider on my own.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Unnecessary. Will mull it over as well.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Duramente...?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Targeting perfection. Refuse less.
Entered shoot bearing family pride.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
For house and clan,
only flawless suffices.
Will bring no shame.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Clashed chasing ideal,
grew stronger together.
Shared goal brought us to same point.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Shared vision — no words needed...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Bearing house pride, chasing same heights,
pushed each other here.
Now steering shoot to perfection.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Agreed. Let us join forces.
Create ultimate PR shots ——
flawless outcome worthy of our family
names.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Current shots...
Vivlos and mine match concept,
Shion's direction clear.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
True,
but exceeding safe execution requires
bold shifts... If achievable ——

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—— Key lies with girl yet to unleash true
power.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...In the end, zero approved shots...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
More I think, more head spins blank...
Must fix this somehow.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Cool,
elegant model...
Sis always best reference.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
—— Right,
copy her image...
goes smoothly this time...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Always calm, composed... radiating aura...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Yes, like this... should feel like this... Uu... Feels completely off when doing it...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Maybe... model-like actions...
Like...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: H-how about this...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina?
text_block_list.text:
Looks grand♪ Next, place hands like this,
will look very cute!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: …………Vi-Vivlos? Wh… what are you doing here…?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Aha, just got back from the pool! More curious, what are you doing, Chevacchi, posing like our big sis?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Wh… why jump to conclusions…?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh? Course I'd know.
Read every magazine 
featuring her.
But is that what Crown wants 
from you here, Chevacchi?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Nowhere else to draw from… dead 
end now that you poked fun at me.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hmmmm… Ah! Then let's go for change of pace☆

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You like quiet places,
right? Pool here gorgeous, 
quiet, huge, total best♪ Come on, go, go♪

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's with you… fine, get it. 
…So pushy…

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: …Hopefully this cheers you up.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: …Quiet, beautiful place… barely anyone around… can relax here… hm?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Camera at that angle… 
I stand here. I see, I see.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: …First shot, facing camera, croisé devant. Second shot, arabesque.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Uwahh? Wh-why here, Cheval?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Umm… change of pace… 
What about you, Shion… doing here…?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Well～ …Ahaha.
Rehearsing… something like that. 
…Tomorrow cannot fail.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow…? Ah, ballet-themed 
photo shoot… for that?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes… today, areas couldn't do well… 
Crown covered by adjusting plan.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Will showcase experience at shoot 
tomorrow, no backup plan needed. Rare 
opportunity to be "principal".

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Principal…

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Photo model…? Me… model…! 
…Wanna try… wanna try!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Photographed means incontestable
"principal" 
subject, right? Invited with plans for 
ballet motif…!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Real deal, couldn't do 
as well as thought. Pathetic outcome,
haha…

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
How it was for you. Um, I… wanted 
to do best as model, but no good…

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
But… properly recognised how to improve. 
Meanwhile, I… completely clueless…

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Reminded of when first met. 
Got anxious easily…

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Whenever something happened, said things 
like that, looking down on self. First, 
wouldn't look at me, haha.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: …Right. Didn't change much since…

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: …………………Cheval, hold still moment.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Eh? Wha…?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Arm like this, then… palm up. 
Leg goes at angle like this.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ballet form…? 
…Whoa, balance…?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Uwah!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Form… not maintained purely 
through muscle strength, right?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, my experience when first 
started too. Countless attempts,
failures, 
never giving up until done.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: However… sure you've done same before.
